subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Tomorrow!
body: Dear valued customer, Get ready for our exclusive summer sale starting tomorrow! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items including swimwear, sandals, and beach accessories. Don't miss out on this great opportunity to update your summer wardrobe at unbeatable prices. Hurry in-store or shop online to grab your favorite pieces before they're gone. We look forward to seeing you at our store!
